title: 2.9 Buses, watches, men and women
unit_outcome: Say where and how people go, what people have and what things are, compare people and things, and understand classroom commands in Spanish.
goal: Say more than one: Un autobús. Dos autobuses. Un hombre. Dos hombres. Ellas son mujeres.
grammar_function: -es plurals (autobuses, relojes) and -s plurals (hombres, mujeres); unos/unas.
prerequisite: Spanish A1 Unit 2 and A1+ Unit 1 and A1+ 2.1-2.8.
speaking_outcome: Say more than one: Un autobús. Dos autobuses. Un hombre. Dos hombres. Ellas son mujeres.
